name: Farhanul Islam
title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
summary: Motivated QA Engineer aiming to ensure high-quality software through effective manual and automated testing, API and UI validation, defect tracking, and close collaboration with development teams.

experience.details:
Developed and implemented comprehensive Test Plans and Strategies for web and mobile enterprise applications, ensuring full coverage and reducing post-release defects.
Performed manual, regression, smoke, and sanity testing to deliver stable, issue-free releases on time.
Analyzed Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) and product requirements to design high-quality test scripts and gain in-depth knowledge of the system under test.
Validated UI/UX using Figma, enhancing user experience and client satisfaction.
Identified, prioritized, and logged critical defects in Google Sheets, collaborating with developers to ensure rapid resolution and improved product quality.
Supported automation testing initiatives with Selenium and Playwright, optimizing QA workflows and accelerating delivery without compromising quality.
Contributed to continuous improvement of QA processes, applying risk-based testing techniques and strengthening overall software reliability.

Conducted manual testing of new learning platform features to validate functionality and user experience.
Executed test cases, identified defects, and documented detailed bug reports for timely resolution.
Prepared structured test reports to support release readiness and overall product quality.

experience.role: QA Trainee – EDGE-CSE CUET Digital Skill Training Project
experience.details:
Completed structured training in manual and automation testing with hands-on use of Selenium, Jira, and Postman.
Gained practical experience in SDLC and STLC activities including test planning, test execution, and defect reporting.
Learned CI/CD pipeline concepts and participated in basic integration and optimization exercises to support modern QA workflows.

Performed end-to-end testing of web applications, including functional and regression testing.
Designed and executed test cases, identifying defects and supporting issue resolution.
Collaborated with team members to improve testing workflows and software quality.

projects.name: Playwright Automation Framework (JavaScript)
projects.details: Automated 7 functional test cases using Playwright (JavaScript) with the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern, and executed cross-browser testing on demo web applications to ensure consistent behavior.

projects.name: Selenium Test Automation – Group Chat Application
projects.details:
Developed automation scripts using Selenium (Java) for group chat features, including role management and session handling.
Validated functional workflows such as admin assignment, user removal, and logout scenarios.

projects.name: Selenium Test Automation – Login & Logout
projects.details:
Automated login and logout scenarios using Selenium (Java), reducing manual regression effort and improving test reliability.
Designed test cases and validated authentication workflows.

projects.name: API Testing with Postman
projects.details:
Performed REST API testing using Postman, validating requests/responses, status codes, and authentication.
Documented defects and ensured data integrity across API endpoints.

projects.name: Election Results Dashboard
projects.details: Developed a responsive dashboard using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to visualize real-time election data, and validated UI behavior and functionality through manual testing.
